comment: The GAIN knobs are configured with an empty name (V105-Quad_CV_Proc.cpp:71-74), so Rack's tooltip for them is blank; the panel prints GAIN 1 to GAIN 4 with markings 0x, 1x and 2x. The inputs and outputs carry whatever you patch in, audio or control voltage, so they are given no family. Gain is the knob times two, with no clamping anywhere.
